title: ml_inference route registration: backend auto-discovery and frontend scene URL
answers: Do I need to edit rest_router.py when adding a product API?
Where is the decision playground URL mapped to a scene?
body:
Backend:
1. products/ml_inference/backend/routes.py:register_routes registers DecisionViewSet on routers.projects (path `ml_inference/decisions`, basename `project_ml_inference_decisions`, parent lookup ["team_id"]).
2. posthog/api/rest_router.py, "Product route auto-discovery" loop at bottom: load_product_modules("routes") then calls each `register_routes(routers)`. No per-product edit there. Registry type is documented in posthog/api/routing.py (RouterRegistry).
3. Discovery is via INSTALLED_APPS: products.ml_inference.backend.apps.MlInferenceConfig is listed in posthog/settings/web.py.
Frontend (separate): products/ml_inference/manifest.tsx maps `/ml-inference/decisions` to the DecisionPlayground scene; frontend/src/productScenes.tsx lazy-imports it.
The loop is eager at ROOT_URLCONF import, not AppConfig.ready() (comment in rest_router.py).
